overview: Prefix-free optimal code by greedy merging two smallest frequencies; total bits and average length.
coreConcept: Har step par sabse kam frequency wale do nodes merge karo.
hinglishExplanation: Huffman tree greedy banta hai. Encoded length = sum(freq x code length). Fibonacci frequencies me skewed tree banta hai.
formalDefinition: Har step par sabse kam frequency wale do nodes merge karo.
importantProperties: Fibonacci frequencies -> chain-like tree (max length n-1).
Ties me codes alag ho sakte hain par cost same.
commonPitfalls: Merged node ko sort me galat jagah.
